title: The History of Europe: Every Year
summary: An animated map showing the borders and populations of European countries for every year since 400 BC. Vassal states and colonies are excluded from population counts.
why: HN users link it whenever a thread needs a quick illustration of how much European borders have shifted and how much conflict there was.
